notes.title: Version 1.0.2 - Minor Update
notes.content: You can now use either WASD or Arrow Keys to control the game board.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 - Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Resolved the following bugs
[list]
[*] Game Recap screen not loading correctly
[*] Certain Achievements were not registering properly
[/list]

notes.title: PokerBall Launch!
notes.content:
An all new puzzle game, using Poker rules!

[list]
[*] Complete levels that get more challenging over time
[*] Challenge yourself in Arcade mode, to see how far you can go
[*] Replay your favorite levels to complete them faster or to get a higher score
[*] All original piano music
 [/list]


Join us in the Community space for details on How To Play, to get a look Behind The Scenes of how the Game Engine works, and to see and discuss Strategies!
